::: {.dc-hero}
Welcome to the DigIQ Monitor, providing recent insights into the digital competence of Dutch citizens aged 10<e2><80><93>100!

This dashboard aggregates data collected using the **DigIQ** to show how confident citizens are in their own digital competence, the knowledge they have about digital media and technology use, and how they perform in this area. It is measured with the following 11 dimensions:
:::
